quantitative_conclusions: J500-J400 best: AbsRel-0.00183100 and RMSE-0.00365350 have scene CIs crossing zero. Delta1+0.00908288 and band-0.00197709 improve with CIs excluding zero; F1-0.00605838 CI[-0.01039984,-0.00140425] worsens. At final all five CIs cross zero.

J500-L500 best: AbsRel-0.00300399,RMSE-0.01059081,delta1+0.00789094 and band-0.00441605 improve with scene CIs excluding zero; F1-0.00677874 CI[-0.01259114,-0.00165636] worsens. At final RMSE,delta1 and band improve with CIs excluding zero; AbsRel and F1 cross zero.

J500-R500 best/final: AbsRel,RMSE and band improve with scene CIs excluding zero; delta1 and F1 cross zero. Best AbsRel-0.00726063 CI[-0.01349520,-0.00122257],band-0.01259220 CI[-0.01650870,-0.00819666].
Against B0 both endpoints improve all four depth/band metrics with CIs excluding zero; F1 best+0.00115944 and final+0.00251736 cross zero. Edge detection is not established as globally improved.

Final-best band+0.00080087 CI[0.00016921,0.00147544] worsens; AbsRel+0.00067662,RMSE-0.00014536,delta1-0.00142439 and F1+0.00135792 cross zero. Endpoint changes are mixed rather than universal collapse.

All comparisons match the same first seed; R500/L500 three-seed means are not used as unmatched comparators. Bootstrap2000,seed320119,62scenes,image-weighted. Intervals describe conditional scene uncertainty, not seed variability; no multiplicity correction.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0598: Final improves AbsRel0.0569->0.0533 and F1 0.430->0.452 with extra matched tabletop fragments. Right side remains patchy and sofa/legs remain missed; still worse than B0.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_1440: Final worsens AbsRel0.1013->0.1046,F1 0.484->0.478; broad errors and displaced chair edges persist, with more incidental unmatched fragments. Both endpoints are worse than B0 on this image.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Very similar depth/edge layout; AbsRel0.1637->0.1641,rounded F1 remains0.520. Foreground matched contour survives alongside false ceiling and missed shelf details. No clear qualitative endpoint improvement.

interpretation: One-seed J500 supports an overall-depth gain over matched L500/R500 but an edge-F1 loss versus L500/J400. J400->500 overall AbsRel increment remains uncertain. Fixed cases contain both benefits and regressions; await the other seeds and Stage comparisons without tuning the frozen protocol.
